title: KiCad Altium SCHLIB File Parsing Out-Of-Bounds Write Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. (CVE-2026-126970)
description: CVE-2026-126970 is a high-severity vulnerability in KiCad related to improper parsing of Altium SCHLIB files. It allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code by exploiting an out-of-bounds write during file parsing. Exploitation requires user interaction, such as opening a malicious file or visiting a malicious page.
